name: ViTPose / ViTPose++
plain: ViTPose and ViTPose++ (base, small, large, huge): top-down 2D human pose with a plain vision transformer, from the weights published by the University of Sydney on Hugging Face. Apache-2.0.
summary: ViTPose (Xu et al. 2022): top-down 2D human pose with a plain ViT encoder and a light deconvolution (or bilinear) decoder; ViTPose++ trains one backbone on six pose datasets with per-dataset MLP experts. Takes person boxes (e.g. from `fastforks.detection`), crops each at 256 x 192 and returns the 17 COCO keypoints with DARK sub-pixel decoding. The portable `module()` maps crops to heatmaps.

papers.title: ViTPose: Simple Vision Transformer Baselines for Human Pose Estimation
ViTPose++: Vision Transformer for Generic Body Pose Estimation

official.reason: The authors' code is built on mmpose; the Hugging Face transformers port is dependency-light and ships the converted weights.

task_io: Input: one RGB image and a box per person. Output: keypoints with confidence scores for every person.
